entities.summary: José Rodrigo Rodrigo was a Spanish military officer who served as Chief of the Defence Staff (Jefe del Estado Mayor de la Defensa, JEMAD) between 1992 and 1996. The office he held made him chief of staff of the Spanish Armed Forces.
